link.title: Integrations
link.description: Connect 3D Bits to the rest of your storefront - your own forms, other apps, and custom front-end code. Not every store wants the built-in option panel: some already have a product form they like, some need a third-party options or subscriptions app in the flow, and some want the 3D scene driven entirely by their own JavaScript. These pages cover driving a configurator from your own form, running the configurator logic without a visible panel at all, and what to do when another app needs to coexist with 3D Bits on the same product.
